name: Youth Entrepreneurship Academy
org: LA County Office of Small Business (Economic Opportunity)
what_you_do: Join a six-week cohort for young people who want to start a business. The page does not list the lessons. It says the academy is for high school and community college youth.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 26. You live in LA County. You were hurt by COVID-19. You can go to all six weeks.
pay_detail: Cost and stipend are not listed.
deadline_text: Cohorts are closed. A waitlist and interest form is on the page. No dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the intake form on the academy page to join the waitlist. Questions: (844) 432-4900 or emi@opportunity.lacounty.gov.
notes: The COVID-19 impact rule is on the page, so confirm you qualify. Schedule, cost and meeting place are not listed. Confirm first.
